newsitem.title: USA: Eott Energy gross margin decline hurt Q2.
newsitem.headline: Eott Energy gross margin decline hurt Q2.

text.p: EOTT Energy Partners LP said Thursday that its second quarter was hurt by a "significant decline" in gross margin, which it said fell from deterioration in grade and basis differentials in North American crude oil markets.
The company reported a second quarter loss of $0.32 per share, compared to a profit of $0.52 per share in the 1996 quarter.

The company said crude differentials began to improve as the second quarter progressed. It said it is renegotiating many of its lease crude oil contracts to align with current market conditions. This should improve performance in the third quarter as the new terms become effective, the company said.
